Everything the Local AI app shows, and what it calls to show it

The design is final. This is the developer's handoff: every screen in the phone-sized panel, how you get from one to the next, what each screen reads from the server, and which routes exist today in local-ai-sandbox/server versus which are new. The desktop fullscreen app shows the same screens as pages under a top bar. Numbers inside the screens are sample data.

64screens
7journeys
151ways between them
13routes exist
1to extend
13new routes

Screen map

One row per journey. Pick a screen to see where it leads (bright) and what leads to it (grey). The machine name and the menu in the header reach Machines and Settings from every screen, so those lines are left out.

Which screen to show

The app keeps no screen state of its own for the main flow. It reads GET /api/state and picks the screen with the first rule that matches. Settings, Models, Usage and the other detail screens are ordinary navigation on top.

  1. GET /api/state failscantconnect
  2. Answer is 401 (opened from another device)key
  3. Chosen device has online = falseunreachable
  4. AppVersion.phase is downloading or restartingapp-updating
  5. docker.ok is false: not installedneedsdocker
  6. docker.ok is false: installed but stoppeddockeroff
  7. gpus is emptynogpu
  8. No group has recipesnothing
  9. A run of ours: phase weightsdl, netwait or checking (by detail)
  10. A run of ours: queued, image, starting, testingwaking, then slow once past its usual load time
  11. A run of ours: readyawake, or opened after Open
  12. A run of ours: unresponsivenoreply
  13. A run of ours: stoppingsleeping
  14. A run of ours: failedroom, quit, never, noengine, locked, space, damaged or noconn, by failure.word
  15. Chosen recipe needs more free GPUs than are freeneeds, or busy when another program holds them
  16. Chosen recipe's weights not on diskfirst
  17. Otherwiseoff

Run phases from engine.js. Under each phase is the screen it shows. Stop and Cancel call DELETE /api/runs/:port from any phase. Two failures the engine can report, "GPU not reaching Docker" and "Driver problem", plus the fallback "Did not start", use the same failure layout with failure.word and failure.line.

Screens

Each screen with what it reads and what each control does. "Calls" is the request a control makes; a dash means it only moves to another screen. Paths like runs[].phase are fields of GET /api/state.

Data

The shapes the screens read. State is the one snapshot everything else hangs off; the rest are the new routes' answers.

State

GET /api/state
{
  name, platform, url, v,
  docker: { ok, error },
  gpus: [{ index, name, total, used }],          // MiB
  free: [index],
  groups: [{ card, name, supported, untested,     // untested = the tested card it borrows from
             gpus: [index], tiers: { fastest, balanced, smartest }, recipes: [RecipeView], hidden }],
  runs: [Run],
  usage: { today, week, all, days: [{ d, v }], models: [{ name, in, out, req }] },
  catalog: { source, commit, at, error, count },
  harnesses: [{ id, name, needs, installed }],    // extend: version, latest, job
  folder, harness, last,
  devices: [{ i, name, url, online, error, state: State }],
  events: [{ at, level, kind, ... }]
}

Run

state.runs[]
{
  id,               // the port it serves on
  recipe, name, gpus: [index], since,
  phase,            // queued · weights · image · starting · testing · ready · unresponsive · stopping · failed
  detail, progress, // progress 0..1 while phase = weights
  error, failure: { word, line },
  view: { word, line, p },
  apis: { openai, responses, anthropic },
  stats: { tps, prefill, tokens }
}

RecipeView

state.groups[].recipes[]
{ id, name, engine, ctx, cards, tps, smart, vision, think, tools, kv,
  speed: { c1, c4, c8, measured, ttft }, sizeGb, released, local }

Desktop

The fullscreen desktop app has a top bar (Home, Models, Agents, Machines, Usage, Settings) and shows the same screens as full pages. Home is the painting with the three picks along the bottom. Keys: 1 to 6 jump to a section, Esc goes back, ← → change the pick, Enter starts.

Open questions

Things the design shows that the build has to decide.

  • Where requests come from, without a gatewayEngines answer on their own ports, so the server never sees a request. It can read client addresses from engine access logs (vLLM and SGLang print them) or sample open connections on each port. The app name only exists where an engine logs the User-Agent; otherwise the row says "Unknown app". Device names come from tailscale whois.
  • Agent installs and updates differ by systemOmarchy installs through mise, Hermes ships with its own desktop app, others use npm or a script. The app needs one install and one update command per agent per system, kept with the agent list.
  • Model cards need the base model's repoThe registry's catalog.models[].hf is often the quantized repo or missing (Gemma 4, Qwen3.8-Flash-Next). Add the base repo to the registry. Nemotron 3.5 Lightning has no card at all; the screen says so.
  • Usage needs two finer countersTokens per model per day are stored today. Today's chart needs hourly buckets and This run needs a counter that starts with the run.
  • App updatesPick the release channel (GitHub Releases with electron-updater is the obvious one; the repo is private, so it needs a token or a public release repo). Engines live in Docker, so restarting the app never stops a model.
  • Your own pictureStored on the machine running Local AI. Another device showing that machine shows its picture. More artwork can be added to the Background list as data.
  • Sample data in the designAgent versions, the usage split by model, request sources, the app version and the Tailscale name are placeholders.
  • The phone appRuns one small model on the phone itself, outside this server. Its screens are here; its runtime is a separate piece of work.
